_about: Ethanol (1) + Isooctane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Pienaar, C.[Cornelia], Schwarz, C.[Cara], Knoetze, J. H.[Johannes H.], Burger, A.[Andries], Vapor Liquid Liquid Equilibria Measurements for the Dehydration of Ethanol, Isopropanol, and n-Propanol via Azeotropic Distillation Using DIPE and Isooctane as Entrainers, J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 537-550
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0089. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.13 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
